target_customer: Developers and enterprises building LLM agents and assistants that need persistent memory and context
problem: LLM apps forget prior conversations and cannot cheaply recall relevant user facts without stuffing the full history into every prompt.
business_model: Usage-based cloud memory API with enterprise and bring-your-own-cloud options; open source Graphiti engine
product_category: Agent memory and temporal knowledge graph

founders.name: Daniel Chalef
founders.background_notes: YC page says engineer turned founder and late-stage operator; education not stated. Other team members named in the Graphiti launch post are not described as co-founders on the YC page.

competitors.name: MemGPT
competitors.what: Research system treating the LLM context window like OS memory tiers

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting facts and entities and maintaining a time-aware graph at low latency is hard engineering; the Graphiti paper appeared in January 2025.

defensibility.rationale: Open source Graphiti and many memory competitors make copying easy; temporal graph is the differentiator.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Memory features were added by frameworks and rivals (LangMem, Mem0, Letta); Zep deprecated its Community Edition and concentrated open source work on Graphiti.

market_need_then: LLM agent builders in 2023 needed memory beyond context windows; MemGPT and LangChain memory modules showed demand.

branding.domain_note: Uses getzep.com, a prefix form of the name

identity.logo: Gradient icon, fuchsia pink brand color per Brandfetch
identity.visual_style: Public-domain landscape paintings on the site

branding.community_and_virality: Graphiti reported 24,000+ GitHub stars on a later YC listing; shares name with unrelated Zep cleaning products brand

brand_strength.rationale: Zep is widely named in agent memory comparisons, driven mostly by the open source repo rather than the name.

outcome_analysis: Zep is active, positioned as an enterprise context layer with customers such as Twin Health, Zscaler and Samsung per its site. Open source Graphiti built developer awareness. The Community Edition was deprecated and focus moved to cloud and Graphiti. Funding is poorly documented, with only aggregator figures, so capital and traction are uncertain.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators list $1.8M Nov 2023, $500K Mar or Apr 2024 from YC, $130K Sep 2024, total about $2.3M to $3.3M, and one profile claims an $8M Lightspeed seed in May 2024 that other sources contradict. No press release found, so no rounds recorded. A $1M ARR by June 2024 claim comes from an aggregator profile. Community Edition deprecation date is conflicting (April 2025 secondhand). Competitor Mem0 and Letta funding rounds fell in 2024 and are not listed as founding-era competition. Round update: rounds rest on aggregators only. CB Insights shows 2.3M over three rounds with a 500K convertible note dated 2024-01-01 (other aggregators date the 500K to March 2024); the 1.8M Nov 2023 figure is consistent with that total but its page was not opened, and the 130K Sept 2024 entry (EveryDev) may overlap. A 451 Research reprint (April 2026) names Y Combinator, Engineering Capital and Step Function as investors with no amounts. Totals of 3.3M and the 8M Lightspeed claim conflict and are not recorded.
